name: Executive Overview
description: A concise decision-oriented report with headline KPIs, the most important trend, key drivers, and recommended actions.

data_requirements.description: The primary measures that best represent the report objective.
calculation_hints: Prefer totals, rates, averages, or counts that directly answer the user goal.

fallback.message: Show only the headline measures that can be computed reliably.

data_requirements.description: The primary measure over an ordered time dimension.
calculation_hints: Aggregate to a time grain that produces no more than 36 points.

fallback.message: No reliable time dimension is available for trend analysis.

data_requirements.description: A ranked categorical breakdown explaining the primary measure.
calculation_hints: Rank categories by the primary measure and retain the top contributors.

fallback.message: Omit the drivers section when no useful comparison dimension exists.

sections.title: Executive Summary
sections.purpose: State the answer, business impact, and most important caveat first.

blocks.title: Headline Metrics
instructions: Show at most four KPIs and preserve their units.

sections.title: Performance Trend
sections.purpose: Show how the main measure changes over time.

blocks.title: Primary Trend

chart_slot.intent: Show the direction, magnitude, and meaningful changes of the primary measure over time.

fallback.message: Show the available time values as a compact table.

instructions: Annotate only material changes supported by the analysis result.

sections.title: Drivers and Recommended Actions
sections.purpose: Explain the largest contributors and translate findings into decisions.

chart_slot.intent: Compare the largest categorical contributors to the primary measure.

fallback.message: Show the ranked contributors as a table.

instructions: Tie every recommendation to an observed result.
Do not invent targets or causes.
